title: Asynchronous Flow Map Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.42018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The order in which tokens are predicted in language modeling has a profound impact on the quality of generated sequences. Autoregressive and masked diffusion models iteratively fill in tokens and can exploit such orderings across generation steps, but how to leverage an ordering for one-step parallel language modeling is unclear. We introduce asynchronous flow map language models (aFMLMs), which incorporate prediction order into one-step modeling by learning the flow maps of asynchronous flows. These flows specify an ordering through a tokenwise time schedule that controls the relative denoising progress of tokens. We formulate a general class of asynchronous flows that admit both prescribed and learned, state-adaptive schedules, show that they define valid flow maps, and develop new methods for their flow map distillation. translated_abstract: 语言建模中预测token的顺序对生成序列的质量有着深远的影响。自回归模型和掩码扩散模型通过迭代填充token，能够在生成步骤之间利用这种顺序，但如何将顺序用于一步式并行语言建模尚不明确。我们提出了异步流映射语言模型，通过学习异步流的流映射，将预测顺序融入一步式建模中。这些流通过逐token的时间调度来指定顺序，该调度控制各token的相对去噪进度。我们构建了一类通用的异步流，它既支持预设的调度，也支持可学习的、状态自适应的调度，证明了它们能够定义有效的流映射，并为其流映射蒸馏开发了新方法。所得到的模型可以通过内化其中编码的顺序，在单次前向传播中生成所有token。
tldr: 提出异步流映射语言模型，通过逐token的时间调度将预测顺序内化到一步式建模中，并配合新的流映射蒸馏方法，实现单次前向传播即可生成全部token的并行语言生成。
en_tdlr: Proposes asynchronous flow map language models (aFMLMs) that internalize token prediction order via tokenwise time schedules and novel flow map distillation, enabling all tokens to be generated in a single forward pass.
